products.name: Jev
products.tagline_zh: Fast, structured AI decisions for software automation
products.description_zh: Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One frontier model: unstructured state in, typed probabilistic decisions out. Instead of generating text, Jev returns Choice, Score, and Noul answers with calibrated probabilities your code can act on. Parallel sampling delivers ~70-500ms responses, about 20-200x faster and 40-400x cheaper than comparable LLM workflows, with output tokens free. Now available to everyone at console.typesafe.ai with no waitlist.

products.name: Sai
products.tagline_zh: The autonomous computer fleet at your command
products.description_zh: Sai is the world's first robosecretary that works with a fleet of autonomous computers, doing your endless screen work. Sai supports Windows, macOS and Linux. 73% on OSWorld.

products.name: Turfs
products.tagline_zh: Keep content across your Mac organized in defined areas
products.description_zh: Use the desktop to keep content from across your Mac accessible and organized in defined areas — or simply keep it clutter-free. A turf can be backed by a real folder, a Finder tag, or your hand-picked selection of files and folders. Turfs stay put through Show Desktop; you choose what Mission Control does with them. Quit, and the desktop is exactly as it was. It replaces Finder's own desktop icon layer, so it can never be sandboxed or sold on the Mac App Store. $29 once, 10-day trial, no card.
